original_test_intent: Physically inspect and cycle the specified Mellanox BF3 cable, verify both endpoint connectors, keying, latches, routing, clearance and bend radius, then confirm the same BF3 endpoints/device and expected link recover without new errors.
original_method: A trained operator binds cable part/serial to both BF3 endpoints and ports, captures photos and pre-link state, drains affected traffic and applies required ESD/network/optical/power isolation, removes/reinserts the cable once per service procedure, restores routing/latches, then compares endpoint/device/driver/link/counter/error evidence after approved reinitialization or reboot.
manual_activity: A trained operator identifies both BF3 cable endpoints, inspects connector/routing condition, performs the single approved reseat and verifies final physical state; the owner reviews physical and Mellanox recovery evidence.
required_inputs: SUT/network topology, BF3 cable part/serial/length/polarity and both BF3 adapter/port identities
Approved BF3 cable service procedure, traffic drain, hot-plug/power and ESD/network/optical requirements
Independent console/network recovery and alternate cable/port escalation path
Camera/evidence labeling, operator identity and no-log-clear policy
safety_requirements: Only a trained operator may handle the BF3 cable under approved ESD, optical/network and power/link controls
Drain affected traffic and do not manipulate live optics or links outside the approved service procedure
Stop on wrong endpoints, connector/latch damage, contamination, excessive force, bend-radius/routing violation, link loss beyond window or new errors
Perform one approved cycle only and diagnose before any repeat
Restore both endpoint latches, strain relief, routing, clearance and approved final link state
agent_execution_scope: Verify row-2007 variant identity and reject copied OSFP Module scope
Collect and compare pre/post Mellanox/BF3 endpoint device/firmware, port speed/width/FEC, link/driver counters and unfiltered errors
Organize endpoint/routing photos, physical-action/recovery timeline and hashes
Flag changed endpoint identity, degraded negotiation, new errors or incomplete physical proof
Perform no cable manipulation, seating/routing verdict, link-change authorization or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact cable/endpoints, traffic drain/safe service sequence, cycle count and recovery plan
Ensure trained operator completes connector/routing inspection and single reseat
Review pre/post BF3 device/link/counter/error evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: CRITICAL MANUAL PHYSICAL MELLANOX BF3 CABLE RESEAT VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a signed two-endpoint BF3 cable checklist with connector/routing photos, safe traffic-drain confirmation, one-cycle timeline and correlated endpoint device, negotiation, counter, driver and error evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects copied OSFP Module scope and adds BF3-specific endpoint identity, routing, link-drain and recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A BF3 link can recover at degraded parameters, while remote data cannot prove latch, keying or bend condition. Both physical and electronic evidence are mandatory.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The cycle can disrupt networking, contaminate or damage high-density connectors, or produce partial recovery that looks like simple link-up.

project_override_considerations: If the BF3 cable is live-serviceable, the exact traffic drain and optical/link isolation sequence must be supplied; otherwise isolate/power down. OSFP module evidence from row 2004 is prohibited.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash plus BF3 cable part/serial/length/polarity, both adapter/port identities and service-procedure revision
Operator identity, ESD/network/optical/safe-state confirmation and labeled before/after endpoint/routing photos
Pre/post endpoint device/firmware, port speed/width/FEC/link/driver counters, recovery timeline and unfiltered errors
One-cycle/no-repeat/no-log-clear audit, restored route/latches/endpoints and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The exact XLSX item is Mellanox - BF3 Cable, while DeepSeek describes OSFP Module. The primary row and GPT V2 provide coherent cable scope, so the copied AI content is isolated.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The source row is reliable and the mismatched AI scope is repairable by isolation. The case remains MANUAL ONLY with operator and recovery prerequisites.

review_improvement: Removes the copied OSFP module narrative, binds the shared code to BF3 cable and adds two-endpoint physical plus negotiation/counter evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: A BF3 cable path must be proven end to end because the same adapter may have multiple ports and nearby cables. A post-cycle link can negotiate at a degraded speed, width or FEC state, so binary link-up is insufficient. Physical inspection covers keying, latches, routing and strain; electronic evidence covers endpoint identity and signal recovery. The OSFP module narrative cannot be generalized because it targets a removable optic/cage rather than this cable path.
